notes.title: Painting mechanic and bug fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Builders![/h1]
In this update, we've fixed several bugs, improved some systems, and added a new mechanic!

[h2]Fixed Bugs:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the character's hands would disappear in certain poses.
[*] Fixed a bug where tools could be grabbed from a distance.
[/list]
[h2]Сhanged mechanics:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked the inventory system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/ab8f7501cd0b417b13aa7c4292179d918a63d88b.jpg[/img]
[*] Trees now yield more logs.
[*] Reworked a system that caused the chainsaw to deal inconsistent and unreliable damage to wood.
[/list]
[h2]New mechanic[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now paint your buildings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/76f45eae9306611339b472f9c6bfcfb98b5c21c1.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[h2]We hope these changes bring some enjoyable variety to your building experience. Good luck out there - and stay safe on the construction site![/h2]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest starts tomorrow! Forest Construction VR is waiting for you!🌲🔨
notes.content:
[h2][b]Steam Next Fest[/b] starts tomorrow, and our game 
Forest Construction VR will take part in it![/h2]

[h2]If you've ever wanted to try building with your own hands in VR — now’s the perfect time to dive in![/h2]

[h3]What awaits you:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Freeform construction using planks, logs, and more
[*] Realistic physics and hands-on tools
[*] A peaceful forest world with immersive natural sounds
[*] Endless room for creativity and experimentation
[/list]
[h3]The demo is already available and will stay up even after the festival — so you can enjoy it anytime![/h3]

[h3]Add the game to your wishlist to stay in the loop on upcoming features and announcements![/h3]

[h3]Thank you for being with us. Build, create, relax.
- Forest Construction VR Team[/h3]

notes.title: Demo 2.0 is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Builders![/h1]
We’re excited to introduce Demo Version 2.0, packed with improvements and new features.

[h2]What’s New in Demo Version 2.0[/h2]

[h3]Expanded and Enhanced Location[/h3]
The world is now significantly larger! We've expanded the playable area and reworked the vegetation and environment — making everything feel more vibrant and alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/f864a49a3f8f217f80db91622b94771a37428351.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Building Material[/h3]
A new type of construction material has been added:
[list]
[*][b]Clay[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/213fdbaa2c72f6e5df0348ad1285037868f938c2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Updated Tools and New Tools[/h3]
We've improved existing tools and added new ones:
[list]
[*] [b]Scythe[/b] – for easily cutting grass.
[*] [b]Chainsaw[/b] – makes harvesting wood effortless.
[*] [b]Jackhammer[/b] – quickly breaks stone and extracts clay.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/0c144cc986334611799f72a481c4223cd0ce0b72.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Crafting Recipes[/h3]
We’ve added new crafting recipes to expand your building possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/7fa9a932d73444b363e451b4c402870bb31b593f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Transportation Upgrades[/h3]
The existing vehicle has been upgraded — it’s now more reliable and easier to handle.
We’ve also added a new type of transport, designed specifically for moving construction materials and equipment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/9f8cb2ec06aaf69af0273e180f618a92829f83a9.jpg[/img]
[h3]Physical Player Body & Movement Improvements[/h3]
We've added a physical body to the player character, along with the ability to jump and climb, making movement feel more natural and immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45075098/a99bde5c912f86091de3e318e5b75ead4d0d026b.jpg[/img]
[h2]We hope you enjoy the new features and have a great time exploring the updated world![/h2]

notes.title: Announcement of big changes in the game!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Builders![/h1]
Initially, we planned to update the main game’s Steam page with new screenshots and visual improvements.

[h1]What does this mean for you?[/h1]

[*] [b]A fully-featured player body[/b]

notes.title: Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, Builders![/h2]
We are excited to announce that we are actively working on the full version of Forest Construction VR and are ready to share key updates.

[h2]Leaving Early Access[/h2]
The game is no longer in early access! The full version will include all planned content, and we will continue releasing updates to improve its quality and scale.

[h2]A New, Large Location Divided into Biomes[/h2]
[h3]The game now features five distinct biomes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Winter Biome – Snow-covered landscapes and a cold climate.
[*] Autumn Biome – Golden leaves and crisp air.
[*] Spring Biome – Awakening nature and fresh greenery.
[*] Dead Forest Biome – A desolate and dry place.
[*] Birch Grove Biome – Cozy and picturesque scenery.
[/list]
[h2]Environment[/h2]
[h3]Compared to the demo version, the world has become much more vibrant and diverse:[/h3]
More trees, bushes, rocks, and natural objects.

[h2]Building Materials[/h2]
[h3]Greater Variety of Building Materials:[/h3]
Four types of logs from different tree species instead of just one.

[h2]Crafting System[/h2]
We are working on a crafting system that will expand construction possibilities and introduce new customization options for buildings.

[h2]And finally[/h2]
Updated screenshots showcasing the final visuals of the full version will be available on the Steam page soon!

[h3]Thank you for following our development![/h3]
